main_text.l: extant, vix eo fensu reperias. Anglis, a
de fuggillato dicunt, black and blue.
Πλατὺς, latus; plate, Item, broad. ἐν πλατείαις, abroad:
πλαδώδης & πλαδαρὸς, uliginofus, udus; a plash,
bene Aristoteles alicubi ducit ex πὲς:)
Πέλλα, proprie, mulctra, feu vas in
quod lac emulgebant. Interdum de a-
liis, ut catino, poculo, &c. Angl. a paile, a milk-paile.

page.notes: Old English words in black letter within the roman text; Greek words printed with accents, some letters uncertain in the scan, e.g. "πίλ⊕" and "πελιδνὸς" readings approximate. Catchword and signature not visible.
